name: Pleasing Gold
oneLiner: PGOLD is Pleasing's gold-backed token; each unit represents one troy ounce of LBMA-standard 99.99% bullion under issuer custody with KYC-gated redemption.
collateral: LBMA-standard 99.99% physical gold with 1 PGOLD representing 1 fine troy ounce; issuer materials describe fully gold-backed reserves and physical redemption support
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed gold-backed token with off-chain custody and redemption workflow; documentation describes physical redemption and delivery through the Pleasing platform subject to KYC and size requirements

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: PGOLD has issuer-native mint surfaces on Arbitrum and Ethereum, an Arbitrum-to-ApeChain LayerZero lock/mint route, and Chainlink CCIP routes whose directory lists an Arbitrum lock/release pool and Ethereum and Pharos burn/mint pools. The external validator and token-pool controls make external-lock-mint the conservative aggregate tier.

routes.reviewNote: Native PGOLD on Arbitrum: token owner() = the same issuer EOA 0x142a96da210dec495a76e56058563549ac12bab4 (verified on-chain 2026-07-20); the OFTAdapter 0xbfd47e6098017c04957ba218dade65e23f661793 (token() = this PGOLD, LayerZero EndpointV2, owner 0x25a6a7fbe039c14b06adb6bda434b960981dbaed) locks it to back the ApeChain OFT representation.

Controller verified on-chain 2026-07-20: endpoint() of the ApeChain PGOLD token returns a LayerZero endpoint (0x6f475642a6e85809b1c36fa62763669b1b48dd5b) and peers(30110) returns the Arbitrum OFTAdapter 0xbfd47e6098017c04957ba218dade65e23f661793, so this deployment is the Pleasing Gold OFT and the OFT contract itself is the mint/burn authority for the representation.
Native PGOLD on Ethereum: token owner() = issuer EOA 0x142a96da210dec495a76e56058563549ac12bab4 (verified on-chain 2026-07-20); no bridge representation.

Chainlink's PGOLD directory, observed 2026-07-22, lists this Pharos deployment with Burn/Mint token pool 0x944ED1b0a0f9de55a21F0372652ba1bF05194AA4; the Arbitrum PGOLD leg is listed with a Lock/Release pool, so the Pharos representation inherits CCIP validation and pool-control risk.

mintAuthority.summary: PGOLD is minted by Pleasing International (Hong Kong) via EOA-controlled token contracts. On Ethereum, the CCIPAdmin EOA (0x142a96da) grants mint roles to the CCIP burn/mint pool (0xf3067615). On Arbitrum, the proxy owner EOA (0x142a96da) can call mint() directly; a separate proxy-admin contract (0x50ead2d2) is owned by a different EOA (0x7e5cc9bb). On ApeChain the token is non-upgradeable, owned by EOA 0x25a6a7fb.

controls.label: Pleasing issuer EOA — Ethereum CCIPAdmin / token owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295079, owner() on 0xfb0bd86210d2a10543bb40289e92d108b3a5334f returned 0x142a96da210dec495a76e56058563549ac12bab4; eth_getCode on that address returned 0x (EOA). getCCIPAdmin() returned the same address. getMinters() returned one address (0xf3067615 CCIP pool contract). The EOA can call grantMintRole/revokeMintRole to control the mint surface.

controls.label: CCIP burn/mint pool — active minter on Ethereum
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295079, getMinters() on the PGOLD ETH token returned [0xf3067615579d59c64f16f1382b6a8032622f810a]; eth_getCode confirms it is a contract (34 KB, Chainlink CCIP burn/mint pool). Minting through this pool requires a corresponding cross-chain message.

controls.label: Pleasing issuer EOA — Arbitrum token owner (direct mint)
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 472413865, owner() on proxy 0x3e76bb02286bfeaa89dd35f11253f2cbce634f91 returned 0x142a96da210dec495a76e56058563549ac12bab4; eth_getCode returns 0x (EOA). The implementation at 0xd81ea1e2179c983a45aa95929f189c2bd59788d7 exposes a plain mint(address,uint256) gated only by Ownable, so the owner EOA can mint directly.

controls.label: Proxy-admin upgrade authority — Arbitrum
controls.evidence: At Arbitrum block 472413865, EIP-1967 proxy-admin slot on 0x3e76bb returned 0x50ead2d211d84d111c692b86e02a489d3aa2e9ce (a ProxyAdmin contract, 3368 bytes). owner() on the ProxyAdmin returned 0x7e5cc9bb562eae2356fae7c59ea04c4677f73986; eth_getCode returns 0x (EOA). A different EOA from the token owner.

controls.label: Pleasing issuer EOA — ApeChain token owner (direct mint)
controls.evidence: On ApeChain, owner() on 0x64ae250e044688ddd04262f17daca23c28d241c2 returned 0x25a6a7fbe039c14b06adb6bda434b960981dbaed; eth_getCode confirms EOA. Contract is not a proxy (EIP-1967 slots are zero). Different issuer EOA from ETH/ARB.

review.evidence: Ethereum block 25295079: owner() = CCIPAdmin = 0x142a96da (EOA); getMinters() = [0xf3067615 CCIP pool, contract]. Arbitrum block 472413865: proxy owner = 0x142a96da (EOA), impl mint() gated only by Ownable; proxy-admin 0x50ead2d2 owned by EOA 0x7e5cc9bb. ApeChain: non-proxy, owner = 0x25a6a7fb (EOA). All on-chain mint surfaces resolved. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): No named independent attestor, recurring cadence, or dated reserve-to-liability report was located; Pleasing Gold provides only issuer-controlled, ad hoc backing claims. No exact prudential stablecoin-issuer authorization for the issuer was found in Hong Kong SFC's public register.
